extraction_summary.methodology_notes: Used systematic batch processing approach with 10 products per batch to avoid timeouts. Combined site-specific searches with pharmaceutical databases for comprehensive data extraction. Second batch includes mix of prescription and OTC products with varying therapeutic classes.
